source: 02_rev2 §6.1-6.3 (four controls, random seeds averaged within image, quality-oriented contrasts); 03_rev1 §8 control_seed; where unspecified, the simple diagnostic conventions below were chosen without looking at control performance
grid: 224x224 model-input grid; pixel (i,j) centre at (i+0.5, j+0.5)

random.aggregation: each of the 5 maps evaluated separately; AUCs averaged WITHIN each image; maps are never averaged; seeds are not independent observations

centre.uses: geometry only; no masks, labels or model outputs
centre.note: radially symmetric: equal-value pixels are ordered by the standard tie-break (ascending flat index)

sobel.input: pre-normalisation RGB on the 224 grid: rgb = x*STD + MEAN (float64, ImageNet constants), i.e. the resized cached image in [0,1] (not re-clipped)
sobel.operation: cross-correlation (as numpy/scipy correlate), no normalisation of kernels
sobel.invalid: a constant (max-min < 1e-12) or non-finite Sobel map is flagged and the control is UNAVAILABLE for that image
sobel.uses: image pixels only; no model gradients or masks

mismatch.order: records in a group sorted by (stable_seed('mismatch_v1', record_uid), record_uid)
mismatch.assignment: cyclic shift by the smallest s >= 1 such that no recipient receives its own map or a map from the same case (same cluster_id; for Derm7pt the case is pair_id); a single global shift within the group is a derangement
mismatch.insufficient: groups with fewer than 2 records, or where no valid shift exists, are UNAVAILABLE
mismatch.donor_invalid: if the donor map is not eligible (shape-invalid, or IG completeness failure) the planned mapping is kept and the control is UNAVAILABLE for that recipient; no replacement donor is chosen
mismatch.persistence: recipient->donor mapping written to disk before any metric is computed

contrasts.sign: positive = better than that control under that metric
contrasts.combination: none; each control type reported separately

evaluation: same image, baseline, S=32 curves_v1 settings, eval_batch and xai_precision_v1 for explainers and controls
